description: This file defines an abstract event class 'LeaveStatusChange' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the leave plugin. It models a leave status change event with associated leaves, workflow state, and performer details.

classes.name: LeaveStatusChange
classes.description: Abstract class representing a leave status change event, containing details about related leaves, workflow state, and user who performed the change.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing leaves, workflow, and performer.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the array of leaves related to this event.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the workflow state machine associated with the event.

methods.name: getPerformer
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the leave status change.
